title: CJP leader announces Mumbai protest at Shivaji Park against detentions
seoTitle: Mumbai CJP protest against leaders' detentions

tea.why: Protesters are demonstrating against the recent preventive detention of several CJP leaders and supporters across Delhi and India.
tea.want: Demonstrators demand the release of detained leaders and the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
tea.changed: Oct 11: CJP leader Ajinkya Shinde announced a protest at Mumbai's Shivaji Park at 4 pm on Sunday.

summary: The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) has announced a protest at T Junction in Shivaji Park, Mumbai, scheduled for Sunday afternoon. The demonstration is organised in response to the preventive arrest and detention of several prominent CJP figures, including Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka, and Saurav Das, by authorities in Delhi and other locations. Newly announced CJP leader Ajinkya Shinde stated on social media that the government is clamping down on democracy and targeting party leadership during ongoing demonstrations over alleged irregularities in electoral rolls. The original wave of protests targeted Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, with protesters demanding his resignation. In response to the planned gathering and recent unrest, Mumbai Police have heightened security measures around Shivaji Park and registered an FIR regarding a previous demonstration at August Kranti Maidan.
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
Release of detained CJP leaders and protesters
response: According to the sources, Mumbai Police have stepped up security arrangements and deployed personnel at Shivaji Park following the protest announcement. Police also registered an FIR at Gamdevi Police Station regarding an earlier demonstration at August Kranti Maidan.

arrests.text: more than 400 people were detained in Mumbai during the demonstration

updates.text: CJP leader Ajinkya Shinde announced a protest at Mumbai's Shivaji Park at 4 pm on Sunday following widespread detentions.
